snippet.textDisplay:
Two things: 1) As a Floridian, this game hits Florida to a T. The dive bar is literally every bar I have ever been to. All the way down to the little jukebox on the wall. Hearing "Palmetto" activated deep neurons that have me thinking, "Mariana County" is supposed to be Manatee County? Ah, the run-down shacks, the sand, it's all a grimy shthole, and I've never felt more seen. The only thing missing is the sweat running down the player's back 10 seconds after stepping outside. 

2) I think when Princess ran away, you were actually supposed to have to chase her. I don't think she was supposed to just sit there 10 feet away. I'm noticing this game definitely has its bugs that are gonna have to be patched.
